painPoints.title: SS7 Network Congestion During Peak Roaming Events
painPoints.description: MIC1 experiences bottlenecks in SS7 signaling capacity during international roaming peaks, causing call setup delays and SMS interworking failures. Current NewNet Communications SS7 stack lacks intelligent congestion management for multi-carrier roaming scenarios.

painPoints.title: Diameter Protocol Fragmentation Across IMS Domains
painPoints.description: MIC1's IMS infrastructure spans multiple geographic regions with inconsistent Diameter routing policies, causing failed authentication and session establishment. NewNet Communications implementation lacks centralized Diameter policy management across federated IMS domains.

painPoints.title: Legacy SIP Interworking with Next-Gen Signaling Overhead
painPoints.description: MIC1 maintains bridging between legacy SIP and next-gen signaling protocols, creating latency and message translation errors. NewNet Communications SIP-to-next-gen conversion lacks real-time protocol optimization.

opportunities.title: Expansion to Advanced SMS Interworking and A2P Gateway
opportunities.description: Implement NewNet Communications enhanced SMS interworking capabilities to enable A2P (Application-to-Person) messaging services. MIC1 can monetize this through enterprise SMS API offerings and increase ARR through tier-based SMS routing tiers.

opportunities.title: Next-Gen Signaling Software Upgrade for 5G Network Slicing
opportunities.description: Upgrade NewNet Communications platform to support 5G SBA (Service-Based Architecture) signaling and network slicing capabilities. This enables MIC1 to offer premium enterprise connectivity services with SLA guarantees, targeting 35-40% ARR uplift over 18 months.
